name: Ukraine
notes: Seed pass started 2026-10-26 and has seventeen source-checked national records, primarily named academic and policy authors plus one official parliamentary speech. Ukrainian-language searches found many property, luxury-goods, income and anti-oligarch measures, which are not wealth-tax evidence under this project’s definition. Parliamentary, party, union, civil-society, regional and local layers remain to be researched. The geography register contains 27 regions, 139 districts and 1,769 hromadas from the CC BY 4.0 Open Admin Data republication of the State Statistics Service’s KATOTTG codifier; the map is the 1,769 hromadas (with district and oblast outlines) from OCHA COD-AB (CC BY-IGO 3.0), which draws Ukraine as it was before 2014, with Crimea and Sevastopol.
